title: Dussilya
text: 1 Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || 2 Dhātuso bhikkhave sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || 3 Asaddhā asaddhehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || ahirikā ahirikehi saddhiṃ- || anottāpino anottāpīhi saddhiṃ- || dussīlā dussīlehi saddhiṃ- || duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || || 4 Saddhā saddhehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || hirimanā hirimanehi saddhiṃ- || ottāpino ottāpīhi saddhimo || [page 167] XIV. 27 . 1] KAMMAPATHAVAGGO TATIYO 167 sīlavanto sīlavantehi saddhiṃ- || paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti || || Dutiyaṃ || ||
